name: IMO SMCP & 해기사 3·4급 & 국제협약 해사영어
description: IMO 총회 결의서 Resolution A.918(22) 공인 SMCP 및 해기사 3·4급 최다 빈출 어휘 451단어 전수 복구 및 고품질 항해 실전 예문 탑재

words.englishDefinition: To evacuate crew and passengers from a vessel following a distress.
words.standardExample: The master gave the emergency order to abandon vessel after uncontainable flooding.
words.exampleMeaning: 선장은 걷잡을 수 없는 침수가 발생하자 선박을 포기하라는 비상 퇴선 명령을 내렸다.

words.englishDefinition: A case of death, injury, or serious loss in an accident or shipping disaster.
words.standardExample: Report all casualties and injured crew members to the search and rescue center.
words.exampleMeaning: 모든 사상자 및 부상 선원 현황을 수색구조센터에 보고하라.

words.englishDefinition: To turn over completely in the water.
words.standardExample: The vessel developed a dangerous list and was in immediate danger of capsizing.
words.exampleMeaning: 선박에 위험한 경사가 발생하여 즉각 전복될 위기에 처했다.

words.englishDefinition: An emergency reversal operation of the main engine(s) to avoid an imminent collision.
words.standardExample: The officer on watch ordered an emergency crash-stop to avoid an imminent collision.
words.exampleMeaning: 당직 항해사는 임박한 충돌을 피하기 위해 비상 후진 급정지를 명령했다.

words.englishDefinition: A group of crew members specially trained for fighting flooding in the vessel.
words.standardExample: The damage control team proceeded to the lower hold with portable submersible pumps.
words.exampleMeaning: 침수 통제반은 이동식 수중 펌프를 지참하고 하부 화물창으로 이동했다.

words.englishDefinition: A vessel or cargo completely abandoned at sea without hope of recovery.
words.standardExample: A derelict fishing vessel was found drifting in the shipping lane without any lights.
words.exampleMeaning: 항로 상에서 등화가 전혀 켜지지 않은 채 표류 중인 유기선 어선이 발견되었다.

words.englishDefinition: A vessel impaired in such a manner as to be incapable of proceeding on its voyage.
words.standardExample: The disabled tanker required two ocean tugs to tow her safely into port.
words.exampleMeaning: 조종 기능을 상실한 유조선을 안전하게 항만으로 입항시키기 위해 대형 예인선 2척이 필요했다.

words.englishDefinition: Radio communication concerning an immediate threat of loss of life or vessel.
words.standardExample: All ships must suspend routine radio calls during distress traffic on VHF Channel 16.
words.exampleMeaning: VHF 16번 채널에서 조난 통신이 진행되는 동안 모든 선박은 일상 무선 통신을 중단해야 한다.

words.englishDefinition: Emergency Position Indicating Radio Beacon for satellite distress alerting.
words.standardExample: Test the satellite EPIRB monthly using the built-in self-test switch without emitting false alerts.
words.exampleMeaning: 오경보를 발신하지 않고 내장된 자체 시험 스위치를 사용하여 위성 EPIRB를 매월 시험하라.

words.englishDefinition: A clearly designated path to safety in case of an emergency onboard.
words.standardExample: All escape routes and emergency exits must be kept completely clear of obstacles.
words.exampleMeaning: 모든 비상 탈출로와 대피구는 장애물이 없도록 완전히 비워 두어야 한다.

words.englishDefinition: A regular check of the vessel to detect and prevent fires.
words.standardExample: The designated duty crew carried out a thorough fire patrol throughout the cargo decks.
words.exampleMeaning: 지정된 당직 선원이 화물 갑판 전체에 걸쳐 철저한 화재 순찰을 실시했다.

words.englishDefinition: Major ingress of water into the vessel holds or compartments.
words.standardExample: High-capacity emergency ballast pumps were started immediately to control the flooding.
words.exampleMeaning: 침수를 억제하기 위해 대용량 비상 밸러스트 펌프가 즉시 가동되었다.

words.englishDefinition: Harmful or toxic smoke, gas, or vapors emitted by chemicals or fire.
words.standardExample: Toxic fumes were released from the damaged chemical drums in the forward hold.
words.exampleMeaning: 선수 화물창의 파손된 케미컬 드럼통에서 유독 가스가 누출되었다.

words.englishDefinition: A signal consisting of seven short blasts followed by one prolonged blast on the whistle and bells.
words.standardExample: Seven short blasts followed by one prolonged blast sounded the general emergency alarm.
words.exampleMeaning: 단음 7회와 장음 1회의 기적 신호로 일반 비상 경보가 명동되었다.

words.englishDefinition: To throw cargo or gear overboard to lighten the vessel and preserve stability.
words.standardExample: The master made the difficult decision to jettison deck cargo to save the listing vessel.
words.exampleMeaning: 선장은 경사된 선박을 구하기 위해 갑판 화물을 해상으로 투하하기로 결단을 내렸다.

words.englishDefinition: Assigned meeting point on deck for embarking lifeboats.
words.standardExample: All passengers and non-essential crew assembled at their assigned lifeboat stations.
words.exampleMeaning: 모든 승객과 비필수 승무원은 각자 지정된 구명정 배치 장소로 집결했다.

words.englishDefinition: To assemble crew and passengers at designated stations for roll call.
words.standardExample: The chief officer took a roll call at the emergency muster to verify that no one was missing.
words.exampleMeaning: 일등항해사는 실종자가 없는지 확인하기 위해 비상 집결 장소에서 인원 점검을 실시했다.

words.englishDefinition: On-Scene Coordinator designated to coordinate search and rescue operations.
words.standardExample: Take immediate corrective measures if any defect is detected in OSC.
words.exampleMeaning: 현장지휘관에서 어떠한 결함이라도 발견될 경우 즉각적인 시정 조치를 취하라.

words.englishDefinition: To pull or lift a stranded or aground vessel back into floating condition.
words.standardExample: Salvage tugs waited for high tide to successfully refloat the grounded container ship.
words.exampleMeaning: 구난 예인선들은 만조 시간을 기다려 좌초된 컨테이너선을 성공적으로 이초시켰다.

words.englishDefinition: Sound or radio signal directing emergency teams to withdraw immediately.
words.standardExample: When the fire spread uncontrollably, the on-scene team leader sounded the retreat signal.
words.exampleMeaning: 화재가 걷잡을 수 없이 번지자 현장 지휘조장은 즉시 후퇴 신호를 울렸다.

words.englishDefinition: Reading aloud a list of names to establish that all persons are present.
words.standardExample: The boatswain performed a strict roll call at the assembly station during the drill.
words.exampleMeaning: 갑판장은 비상 훈련 중 집결 장소에서 엄격한 인원 점검 호명을 실시했다.

words.englishDefinition: Search and Rescue operations to assist persons in distress at sea.
words.standardExample: Standard operating procedures must be observed when operating SAR.
words.exampleMeaning: 수색 및 구조을(를) 취급 및 운용할 때는 표준 작업 지침을 반드시 준수해야 한다.

words.englishDefinition: A predetermined flight or navigational track used to systematically search an area.
words.standardExample: Double-check the settings for search pattern before navigating through heavy traffic areas.
words.exampleMeaning: 선박 통항 밀집 해역을 항해하기 전에 수색 방식의 설정 상태를 재확인하라.

words.englishDefinition: The recommended safe speed maintained by vessels during search operations.
words.standardExample: Maintain clear communication between stations while handling search speed.
words.exampleMeaning: 수색 속력 작업을 진행하는 동안 각 작업 배치 부서 간에 명확한 통신을 유지하라.

words.englishDefinition: Accidental discharge of oil or dangerous cargo into the sea.
words.standardExample: The spill control team deployed oil booms to contain the bunker fuel oil spill.
words.exampleMeaning: 방제반은 벙커C유 유출 확산을 막기 위해 신속히 오일펜스를 설치했다.

words.englishDefinition: Anti-pollution equipment like booms and absorbents used to contain spills.
words.standardExample: All watchkeeping crew must comply strictly with regulations concerning spill control gear.
words.exampleMeaning: 모든 당직 선원은 오염 방제 장비에 관한 안전 규정을 철저히 준수해야 한다.

words.englishDefinition: To be ready to act or assist on short notice.
words.standardExample: The engine room was instructed to stand by for sudden maneuvering orders.
words.exampleMeaning: 기관실은 급격한 조선 명령에 대비하여 즉각 대기하라는 지시를 받았다.

words.englishDefinition: To keep away from dangerous machinery, ropes under tension, or hazardous cargo.
words.standardExample: All personnel were ordered to stand clear of the snap-back zone of the mooring ropes.
words.exampleMeaning: 모든 인원은 계류줄 파단 반동 구역으로부터 안전하게 떨어져 있으라는 명령을 받았다.

words.englishDefinition: A person who has lived through a disaster or accident at sea.
words.standardExample: Three survivors clinging to an upturned liferaft were rescued by the coast guard.
words.exampleMeaning: 뒤집힌 구명뗏목에 매달려 있던 생존자 3명이 해양경찰에 의해 무사히 구조되었다.

words.englishDefinition: A sunken or severely battered vessel resting on the seabed.
words.standardExample: The sunken wreck was marked with an emergency wreck marking buoy flashing green and yellow.
words.exampleMeaning: 침몰선은 녹색과 황색으로 점멸하는 비상 침선 표시 등부표로 표시되었다.

words.englishDefinition: A folding ladder attached to the vessel side for embarking and disembarking.
words.standardExample: The pilot requested the crew to lower the accommodation ladder combined with the rope ladder.
words.exampleMeaning: 도선사는 승무원들에게 줄사다리와 조합된 현문 사다리를 내려줄 것을 요청했다.

words.englishDefinition: Floating at sea without propulsion, anchor, or control.
words.standardExample: The unpowered barge broke its mooring lines and went adrift in the busy fairway.
words.exampleMeaning: 무동력 부선이 계류줄이 끊어지면서 혼잡한 항로 한가운데로 표류했다.

words.englishDefinition: The vertical distance from the waterline to the highest point of the vessel.
words.standardExample: The ship checked its air draft to ensure safe clearance under the suspension bridge.
words.exampleMeaning: 선박은 현수교 아래를 안전하게 통과할 수 있도록 수면상 최대 높이(에어 드래프트)를 확인했다.

words.englishDefinition: Designated gathering point for passengers and crew during an alarm.
words.standardExample: Standard operating procedures must be observed when operating assembly station.
words.exampleMeaning: 비상 집결지을(를) 취급 및 운용할 때는 표준 작업 지침을 반드시 준수해야 한다.

words.englishDefinition: Shifting of the wind in an anti-clockwise direction (e.g., North to West).
words.standardExample: Double-check the settings for backing before navigating through heavy traffic areas.
words.exampleMeaning: 선박 통항 밀집 해역을 항해하기 전에 반시계 방향 풍향 변화의 설정 상태를 재확인하라.

words.englishDefinition: To run a damaged vessel onto a shallow beach to prevent sinking in deep water.
words.standardExample: Maintain clear communication between stations while handling beach.
words.exampleMeaning: 임의 좌주시키다 작업을 진행하는 동안 각 작업 배치 부서 간에 명확한 통신을 유지하라.

words.englishDefinition: A designated space alongside a pier or quay where a ship is moored.
words.standardExample: The vessel gave a wide berth to the shallow reef marked on the nautical chart.
words.exampleMeaning: 선박은 해도에 표시된 천소 암초로부터 충분히 안전 거리를 두고 우회 항해했다.

words.englishDefinition: A loud sound produced by the ship whistle.
words.standardExample: All watchkeeping crew must comply strictly with regulations concerning blast.
words.exampleMeaning: 모든 당직 선원은 기적 신호에 관한 안전 규정을 철저히 준수해야 한다.

words.englishDefinition: An angular sector shielded by masts or funnel where radar cannot detect targets.
words.standardExample: The duty officer made a formal entry in the ship's logbook regarding blind sector.
words.exampleMeaning: 당직 항해사는 맹목 구간에 관한 사항을 항해일지에 공식적으로 기록했다.

words.englishDefinition: The act of coming onto or entering a vessel.
words.standardExample: Ensure boarding is thoroughly monitored throughout the coastal passage.
words.exampleMeaning: 연안 항해를 진행하는 동안 승선이(가) 빈틈없이 감시 및 관리되도록 하라.

words.englishDefinition: Heavy anchor chain, mooring wire, or a nautical distance unit equal to 0.1 nautical mile.
words.standardExample: The CPA of the approaching vessel was accurately determined as three cables.
words.exampleMeaning: 접근 중인 선박과의 최근접거리(CPA)는 정확히 3케이블(약 555m)로 측정되었다.

words.englishDefinition: The four principal compass directions: North, East, South, and West.
words.standardExample: The compass rose displays the four principal cardinal points: North, East, South, and West.
words.exampleMeaning: 나침반 방위반에는 북, 동, 남, 서라는 4대 기본 방위가 표시되어 있다.

words.englishDefinition: To regulate or ease the paying out of a mooring line or wire under tension.
words.standardExample: Proper maintenance of check is essential to ensure navigational safety.
words.exampleMeaning: 항해 안전을 확보하기 위해서는 제어하다의 철저한 유지 관리가 필수적이다.

words.englishDefinition: Towing a vessel firmly nested into an icebreaker stern notch in polar ice.
words.standardExample: Report the exact reading and parameters of close-coupled towing directly to the bridge.
words.exampleMeaning: 밀착 예인의 정확한 측정 수치와 상태를 선교에 직접 보고하라.

words.englishDefinition: A group of merchant vessels sailing together under protection or icebreaker escort.
words.standardExample: Merchant vessels formed a protected convoy to transit safely through ice-covered waters.
words.exampleMeaning: 상선들은 빙해 수역을 안전하게 통과하기 위해 쇄빙선을 동반한 호송 선단을 구성했다.

words.englishDefinition: The intended direction in which a vessel is steered through the water.
words.standardExample: The helmsman was ordered to alter course ten degrees to port to follow the fairway.
words.exampleMeaning: 조타수는 항로를 따라가기 위해 좌현으로 10도 변침하라는 명령을 받았다.

words.englishDefinition: Closest Point of Approach: minimum predicted distance between two passing vessels.
words.standardExample: Double-check the settings for CPA before navigating through heavy traffic areas.
words.exampleMeaning: 선박 통항 밀집 해역을 항해하기 전에 최근접점의 설정 상태를 재확인하라.

words.englishDefinition: Time to Closest Point of Approach: time remaining until reaching the CPA.
words.standardExample: Maintain clear communication between stations while handling TCPA.
words.exampleMeaning: 최근접점 도달시간 작업을 진행하는 동안 각 작업 배치 부서 간에 명확한 통신을 유지하라.

words.englishDefinition: Most probable target position in SAR, or the zero reference level for chart depths.
words.standardExample: Check and verify the operational condition of datum prior to entering the harbor.
words.exampleMeaning: 항만에 진입하기 전에 조난 추정 위치의 작동 및 준비 상태를 확인하고 점검하라.

words.englishDefinition: The designated terminal port a ship is sailing toward.
words.standardExample: All watchkeeping crew must comply strictly with regulations concerning destination.
words.exampleMeaning: 모든 당직 선원은 목적지에 관한 안전 규정을 철저히 준수해야 한다.

words.englishDefinition: To leave or step off from a vessel to the shore or another boat.
words.standardExample: The duty officer made a formal entry in the ship's logbook regarding disembark.
words.exampleMeaning: 당직 항해사는 하선하다에 관한 사항을 항해일지에 공식적으로 기록했다.

words.englishDefinition: The vertical depth of water drawn by a floating vessel.
words.standardExample: Ensure draft is thoroughly monitored throughout the coastal passage.
words.exampleMeaning: 연안 항해를 진행하는 동안 흘수이(가) 빈틈없이 감시 및 관리되도록 하라.

words.englishDefinition: Movement of a vessel over ground caused entirely by currents and wind.
words.standardExample: The master instructed the deck department to prepare drifting without delay.
words.exampleMeaning: 선장은 갑판부에 지체 없이 표류을(를) 준비하도록 지시했다.

words.englishDefinition: To slow down intentionally and fall behind the leading ship in a convoy.
words.standardExample: Take immediate corrective measures if any defect is detected in drop back.
words.exampleMeaning: 뒤로 처지다에서 어떠한 결함이라도 발견될 경우 즉각적인 시정 조치를 취하라.

words.englishDefinition: To go aboard a vessel.
words.standardExample: Proper maintenance of embark is essential to ensure navigational safety.
words.exampleMeaning: 항해 안전을 확보하기 위해서는 승선하다의 철저한 유지 관리가 필수적이다.

words.englishDefinition: A tug or pilot boat attending a vessel for safe navigation through tight waters.
words.standardExample: Report the exact reading and parameters of escort directly to the bridge.
words.exampleMeaning: 호송선의 정확한 측정 수치와 상태를 선교에 직접 보고하라.

words.englishDefinition: Estimated Time of Arrival at a waypoint, pilot station, or port.
words.standardExample: The safety inspector carefully examined ETA during the annual survey.
words.exampleMeaning: 안전 검사관은 연례 선박 검사 중에 입항 예정 시각을(를) 면밀히 검사했다.

words.englishDefinition: Estimated Time of Departure from a port or berth.
words.standardExample: Standard operating procedures must be observed when operating ETD.
words.exampleMeaning: 출항 예정 시각을(를) 취급 및 운용할 때는 표준 작업 지침을 반드시 준수해야 한다.

words.englishDefinition: The navigable channel of a river, harbor, or coastal approach.
words.standardExample: Deep-draft vessels have absolute right of way inside the dredged harbor fairway.
words.exampleMeaning: 준설된 항만 통항로 내에서는 심흘수선이 절대적인 우선 통항권을 갖는다.

words.englishDefinition: Traditional maritime depth measurement unit equal to 6 feet (1.8288 meters).
words.standardExample: Maintain clear communication between stations while handling fathom.
words.exampleMeaning: 패덤 작업을 진행하는 동안 각 작업 배치 부서 간에 명확한 통신을 유지하라.

words.englishDefinition: Entangled or obstructed (e.g. foul anchor snagged on underwater cable).
words.standardExample: Check and verify the operational condition of foul prior to entering the harbor.
words.exampleMeaning: 항만에 진입하기 전에 얽힌의 작동 및 준비 상태를 확인하고 점검하라.

words.englishDefinition: The vessel required by steering rules to keep out of the way of another vessel.
words.standardExample: All watchkeeping crew must comply strictly with regulations concerning give-way vessel.
words.exampleMeaning: 모든 당직 선원은 피항선에 관한 안전 규정을 철저히 준수해야 한다.

words.englishDefinition: Global Positioning System for accurate geographic positioning.
words.standardExample: The duty officer made a formal entry in the ship's logbook regarding GPS.
words.exampleMeaning: 당직 항해사는 위성항법장치에 관한 사항을 항해일지에 공식적으로 기록했다.

words.englishDefinition: The four intermediate compass points: North-East, South-East, South-West, North-West.
words.standardExample: Ensure half cardinal points is thoroughly monitored throughout the coastal passage.
words.exampleMeaning: 연안 항해를 진행하는 동안 팔방위이(가) 빈틈없이 감시 및 관리되도록 하라.

words.englishDefinition: A vessel restricted in her ability to maneuver as required by collision rules.
words.standardExample: The master instructed the deck department to prepare hampered vessel without delay.
words.exampleMeaning: 선장은 갑판부에 지체 없이 조종 제한선을(를) 준비하도록 지시했다.

words.englishDefinition: The instantaneous compass direction in which the longitudinal axis of a vessel points.
words.standardExample: Take immediate corrective measures if any defect is detected in heading.
words.exampleMeaning: 선수 방위에서 어떠한 결함이라도 발견될 경우 즉각적인 시정 조치를 취하라.

words.englishDefinition: To lift or pull up using a crane, derrick, or helicopter hoist sling.
words.standardExample: Proper maintenance of hoist is essential to ensure navigational safety.
words.exampleMeaning: 항해 안전을 확보하기 위해서는 달아올리다의 철저한 유지 관리가 필수적이다.

words.englishDefinition: Accumulation of ice on ship decks and superstructure from freezing sea spray.
words.standardExample: Report the exact reading and parameters of icing directly to the bridge.
